metadata.frame: J2000 (ICRF-compatible inertial axes; SPK frame id 1)
metadata.origin: Solar System Barycenter (NAIF ID 0) via center chains
metadata.timeScale: TDB (Barycentric Dynamical Time); epochs are ET seconds past J2000 (JD 2451545.0 TDB)
metadata.segmentTypeNote: Chebyshev position-only; velocity obtained by differentiating the position polynomial with chain-rule scaling 1/RADIUS. No Type 3 (separate velocity polynomials) segments are present in de440s.bsp.

bodyNotes.mars: Mars SYSTEM BARYCENTER (NAIF 4), not Mars center (NAIF 499); 499 is absent from de440s.bsp.
bodyNotes.earth: Earth GEOCENTER (NAIF 399) via Earth-Moon barycenter (NAIF 3), not EMB (NAIF 3) itself.
bodyNotes.emb: Earth-Moon barycenter helper for chain composition; not part of the SN2 supported set.

metadata.note: Genuine DE440s Type-2 Chebyshev records (midpoint, radius, coefficients) extracted verbatim; no refitting or resampling. Runtime converts km->m on output.

generation.recordFormat: [MID_s, RADIUS_s, X_0..X_PD, Y_0..Y_PD, Z_0..Z_PD], coefficients in km
generation.normalization: u = (t - MID) / RADIUS, valid for u in [-1, 1]
